MIRO_CREATE_TAG.description: Tool to create a new tag on a Miro board. Use when you need to add a new tag with a specific title and color to categorize board items.

title.description: Text of the tag. Case-sensitive. Must be unique within the board.

boardId.description: Unique identifier (ID) of the board where you want to create the tag.

fillColor.description: Fill color for the tag. Choose from predefined color options. Defaults to 'red' if not specified.

PAGERDUTY_CREATE_HANDOFF_NOTIFICATION_RU.description: Creates a new on-call handoff notification rule for a specific user in PagerDuty. This endpoint allows you to set up automated notifications for when a user is about to start or end their on-call shift. It defines how and when the user should be notified about upcoming handoffs, helping to ensure smooth transitions between on-call periods. Use this when you need to establish or modify the way a user is informed about their on-call responsibilities. The rule can be set for incoming shifts, outgoing shifts, or both, and can use various contact methods like email, phone, push notifications, or SMS. Note that this endpoint creates a new rule and does not modify existing ones.

id.description: The ID of the user for whom to create the handoff notification rule.

oncall__handoff__notification__rule__id.description: The ID of the handoff notification rule. This is typically auto-generated by PagerDuty and should be omitted when creating a new rule.

oncall__handoff__notification__rule__han.description: The type of handoff for which to send notifications. Must be one of: 'oncall' (notify when going on-call), 'offcall' (notify when going off-call), or 'both' (notify for both).

oncall__handoff__notification__rule__con.description: The contact method to use for this notification rule. Must be an object with 'id' and 'type' fields. The 'id' should be a valid contact method ID for this user (obtainable via the retrieve_user_contact_methods_via_id action). The 'type' must be one of: 'email_contact_method', 'sms_contact_method', 'phone_contact_method', 'push_notification_contact_method', 'slack_contact_method', or 'whatsapp_contact_method'. Example: {'id': 'PXXXXXX', 'type': 'email_contact_method'}

oncall__handoff__notification__rule__not.description: The number of minutes before the handoff when the notification should be sent. Must be between 0 and 2880 (48 hours). Default is 0 (at the time of handoff).

data.description: Core data for a card item.

cardTheme.description: Hex value of the border color of the card. Default: #2d9bf0

style.description: Styling options for a card item.

id.description: Unique identifier of the parent frame for the card

parent.description: Parent item reference for nesting a card.

board_id.description: Unique identifier of the board where the card will be created

width.description: Width of the card in pixels

height.description: Height of the card in pixels

rotation.description: Rotation angle in degrees. Positive values rotate clockwise, negative counterclockwise

geometry.description: Geometrical dimensions for a card item.

x.description: X-axis coordinate on the board. Default: 0. Center point is x: 0, y: 0

y.description: Y-axis coordinate on the board. Default: 0. Center point is x: 0, y: 0

position.description: Board position for a card item.

MIRO_ATTACH_TAG_TO_ITEM.description: Tool to attach an existing tag to a specific item on a Miro board. Use when you need to associate a tag with an item after confirming the board, item, and tag IDs. Note that card and sticky note items can have up to 8 tags.

tag_id.description: Unique identifier of the tag to attach to the item.

item_id.description: Unique identifier of the item to attach the tag to. Card and sticky note items can have up to 8 tags.

board_id.description: Unique identifier of the board containing the item.
